guidebook.intro: Wakristo, Waislamu na waumini wengine huishi pamoja, na baraka ni sehemu ya mazungumzo ya kila siku.

tips.title: Kutendwa: be + -ed
body: **-w-** ya Kiswahili (**-itwa**, **-pendwa**) ni **be + kitenzi cha tatu** kwa Kiingereza: **is called** (anaitwa), **is loved** (anapendwa).
**Alizaliwa** ni **he/she was born**: **I was born in Mombasa.** Usiseme “I born”.

culture.title: God bless you
body: **God bless you** husemwa pia mtu akipiga chafya, au kwa kifupi **Bless you!** Jibu ni **Thank you.**
